Message:
The world remains wounded
because of me.

Everyone tells me,
“You were only being
controlled by a demon,”
but that is simply not true.

Everything was brought about
by my own foolishness.
This is my sin.

And even now,
that demon still
lurks within me...

I have no right to
beg for forgiveness,
nor any right to grieve.

So, I shall give my own life
to eradicate all demons.

For that is the only way
I am allowed to atone,
and the reason I still live.
